title: Global venture investment hit a record $189B in February, up close to 780% YoY, amid the AI boom; 83% of the month's total went to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Waymo (Gené Teare/Crunchbase News)
summary: Gené Teare / Crunchbase News: Global venture investment hit a record $189B in February, up close to 780% YoY, amid the AI boom; 83% of the month's total went to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Waymo — Crunchbase data shows global venture investment totaled $189 billion in February — the largest startup funding month on record …
contentText:
Gené Teare / Crunchbase News :

Global venture investment hit a record $189B in February, up close to 780% YoY, amid the AI boom; 83% of the month's total went to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Waymo   —  Crunchbase data shows global venture investment totaled $189 billion in February — the largest startup funding month on record …
